summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature in rich/progress.py (private _BinaryReader and _ReaderContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file), added 14 tests in tests/test_progress.py, added reading sections to docs/source/progress.rst, and added one CHANGELOG.md entry under Unreleased/Added. The diff is additive only (no deleted lines). I did not run tests, black, isort, or mypy, since the instructions prohibited running repository code; verification was by reading only. Caveats: a missing path raises ValueError instead of FileNotFoundError (per spec), and a failed open can leave a task behind because the task is added before the file is opened (per spec ordering). Nothing was committed.
